scripts.test: npm run test:unit:coverage && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:e2e && start-server-and-test 'vite preview --outDir dist-e2e --port 8085 --strictPort' http://localhost:8085 'tsx scripts/e2e-shard.ts'
scripts.test:e2e:serial: npm run build:e2e && start-server-and-test 'npm run backend:demo' http-get://localhost:3000 'vite preview --outDir dist-e2e --port 8085 --strictPort' http://localhost:8085 "cypress run --e2e --spec 'tests/e2e/specs/**/*.cy.ts,src/modules/*/tests/e2e/!(*.visual).cy.ts'"
scripts.test:e2e:visual: npm run build:e2e && start-server-and-test 'npm run backend:demo' http-get://localhost:3000 'vite preview --outDir dist-e2e --port 8085 --strictPort' http://localhost:8085 "cypress run --e2e --spec 'tests/e2e/visual/**/*.cy.ts,src/modules/*/tests/e2e/*.visual.cy.ts'"
scripts.test:e2e:visual:update: npm run build:e2e && start-server-and-test 'npm run backend:demo' http-get://localhost:3000 'vite preview --outDir dist-e2e --port 8085 --strictPort' http://localhost:8085 "cypress run --e2e --spec 'tests/e2e/visual/**/*.cy.ts,src/modules/*/tests/e2e/*.visual.cy.ts' --env updateSnapshots=true"
scripts.test:e2e:live: npm run build:e2e && start-server-and-test 'vite preview --outDir dist-e2e --port 8085 --strictPort' http://localhost:8085 "cross-env CYPRESS_liveProfile=true cypress run --e2e --spec 'tests/e2e/specs/**/*.cy.ts,src/modules/*/tests/e2e/!(*.visual).cy.ts'"
scripts.test:e2e:dev: start-server-and-test 'npm run backend:demo' http-get://localhost:3000 'vite dev --port 8085' http://localhost:8085 'cypress open --e2e'
scripts.compose:restart: npm run compose -- down && npm run compose -- up -d
scripts.compose:rebuild: npm run compose -- down -v && npm run compose -- build --no-cache && npm run compose -- up -d
scripts.regenerate: npm run gen:api && npm run gen:asyncapi && npm run prettier:fix
scripts.complete:gates: npm run lint:openapi && npm run lint:asyncapi && npm run check:asyncapi-types && npm run check:spec-identity && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.complete: npm run lint && npm run prettier:check && npm run complete:gates
scripts.complete:fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run lint && npm run prettier:fix && npm run complete:gates
scripts.complete:manual: npm run test:e2e:visual && npm run test:e2e:live
scripts.test:e2e:spec: npm run build:e2e && start-server-and-test 'npm run backend:demo' http-get://localhost:3000 'vite preview --outDir dist-e2e --port 8085 --strictPort' http://localhost:8085 'cypress run --e2e --spec "${E2E_SPEC:-src/modules/*/tests/e2e/**/*.cy.ts}"'
